description: Returns the shops selling one product, one offer per shop (its best, with a count of its other offers), cheapest first by total price including shipping (price alone where a shop's shipping is unknown), with each amount also converted to the market's currency. Offers that are in stock come first. Out-of-stock offers are left out unless include_out_of_stock is true, and only shops that ship to the market are listed unless include_other_markets is true. The result includes the url of the product's Plendio page.

include_other_markets.description: Also list shops not known to ship to the market. Default false.

include_out_of_stock.description: Also list offers that are out of stock or discontinued. Default false: only offers a shopper can order now.

market.description: Market the shopper is in: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

product_id.description: Plendio product id (the id field of a search result, or the number at the end of a Plendio product URL).

name: compare_prices

offers.description: Cheapest first, by total price including shipping (price alone where shipping is unknown).

availability.description: in_stock, out_of_stock, preorder, backorder, discontinued or unknown.

condition.description: new, refurbished or used, when the shop says.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the shop prices in.

delivery_days.description: Estimated delivery, e.g. "1-3" days, when known.

last_seen.description: When Plendio last saw this price (RFC 3339).

market_currency.description: The market's currency price_market and total_market are in.

more_offers.description: How many further offers this shop has for the product (other colours or variants, dearer or out of stock); only this shop's best one is listed.

price.description: Item price in major units of currency, including VAT.

price_market.description: price converted to market_currency (equal to price when the shop prices in that currency); absent when no exchange rate is available.

price_stale.description: True when the price was not confirmed recently; check it at the shop.

shipping.description: Shipping cost to the market in major units; 0 is free shipping; absent when unknown.

ships_to_market.description: Whether the shop delivers to the market: yes (the shop or its platform says so), probably, no, or unknown.

shop_country.description: ISO 3166 country the shop is in.

total.description: Price plus shipping; absent when shipping is unknown (then compare on price alone).

offers_omitted.description: Offers left out because their shop does not ship to the market.

out_of_stock_omitted.description: Offers left out because they are out of stock or discontinued (set include_out_of_stock to list them).

current.description: Cheapest price now; absent when nobody sells it.

days.description: Length of the recorded history in days (at most 365).

since.description: First day of the recorded history (YYYY-MM-DD).

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

title: Compare prices
